top_signals.title: Indonesia’s New Labor Law Tilts the Balance Back Toward Workers
top_signals.summary: Indonesia rolled back parts of a business-friendly labor law, tightening restrictions on outsourcing and fixed-term contracts.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Spiko raises $90 million to expand tokenized cash funds across markets
top_signals.summary: Spiko raised $90 million in Series B funding to scale its $2.7 billion tokenized cash fund business and expand into new markets.
